## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New language feature
- [ ] New library / rewrite
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / CI

## Verification

- [ ] `python tools/check.py` passes (all checks)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, including differential tests where an oracle exists
- [ ] `docs/GRAMMAR.md`, `docs/REFERENCE.md`, and `docs/ROADMAP.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Any new third-party material has a `SOURCE.md` and an entry in `NOTICE`

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to.
